item.title: Data Center Customers Are Reportedly Footing A Bigger Bill For A Superior HBM Supply Chain, Where Samsung Has An Edge, As It’s Estimated To Charge Up To 25% Extra
item.description: All memory manufacturers might be enjoying a profit surge, but none of them are equal when it comes to charging their lucrative customers, which, in this case, are data centers. In fact, the ability of companies like Samsung, Micron, SK hynix, and CXMT to charge more solely depends on how reliable they are in fulfilling shipments. According to an interview, the Korean giant is estimated to charge up to 25 percent more than its rivals, because it can back up its claims of a steady supply. item.title: CXMT’s Rigid DRAM Pricing Means Rejecting Lucrative Global Giants Like Apple, But That’s Because The Company Has A Far Greater Goal; Achieving China’s Self-Sufficiency
item.description: Manufacturers from non-memory sectors are bending over backwards for Apple, offering the technology giant attractive discounts in exchange for long-term business contracts. When it comes to the DRAM category, CXMT isn’t offering any concessions, as a new report states that the Chinese firm not only aims to compete with Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix, but it is also rejecting deals with foreign customers to complete a Herculean task: obtaining self-sufficiency in China’s memory sector.
